lines: Statement by Dr. Janak Raj

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 55.      The impact of COVID-19 on economic activity has turned out to be much more

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: acute than initially expected with the nation-wide lockdown having been extended from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: initial 3 weeks to 9 weeks. There is still uncertainty as to when the epidemiological

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: curve will flatten and this will continue to cloud the macroeconomic outlook for some

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: more time. Be that as it may, we are staring at a huge negative growth in the current

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: quarter and overall negative growth for the year as a whole. Both demand and supply

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: sides of the economy have collapsed. However, I believe that supplies would recover

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: much faster than demand. This is because capacity to produce goods and services by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and large remains intact, though non-availability of labour may temporarily hamper

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: production for a few months. On the other hand, however, there has been a substantial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: loss of demand. A large number of daily labourers/wage earners have been rendered

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: jobless because of lockdown. Though a part of the unemployed work force will get

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: back to work, still there are some sectors which have been hit hard and many people

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: working in these sectors may have lost their jobs permanently. This will adversely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: affect private consumption. Otherwise also, consumer confidence has been dented

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and consumers are likely to cut down on discretionary spending.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 56.     Within aggregate demand, while private consumption is likely to slowdown from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the pre-COVID-19 levels, what worries me more is investment demand, which is likely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to be impacted severely for a variety of reasons. First, given the collapse in demand,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: excess capacity is likely to be created in many sectors. This, combined with huge

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: uncertainty about future demand, both domestic and external, is likely to hamper new

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: investments in the private sector. Second, financing of investment activity – from own

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: sources due to a decline in profitability or by borrowing due to weak balance sheets –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: will also be a challenge. Third, the focus of government spending, both by the Centre

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and the States, will also be on revenue expenditure than on capital expenditure. For

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: all these reasons, investment activity, which contracted in last two quarters, is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected to be severely hit, going forward.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 57.     Moving on to inflation, the NSO has released data only on the food and housing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: groups for April 2020. Food inflation rose to 8.6 per cent in April from 7.8 per cent in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: March. However, these numbers need to be interpreted with a caution as the rise in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: food prices in April was caused by a disruption in supply lines and is transitory. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: wedge between CPI inflation and WPI inflation for food in April widened sharply by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: more than 500 bps. While CPI food inflation increased by close to 80 bps in April, WPI

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation declined by 190 bps from 5.5 per cent to 3.6 per cent, suggesting an increase

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in margins at a retail level due to supply bottlenecks. Should monsoon be normal, as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: it has been forecast, it should also have a salutary effect on food inflation. I, therefore,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: feel that risks to food inflation, other than in pulses, are minimal at this stage and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: overall food inflation is expected to resume its downward trajectory from May/June.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 58.    Though the print of CPI fuel inflation was not available for April, data from oil

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: market companies suggest that domestic LPG and kerosene plunged in April in line

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: with a decline in global prices.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 59.     Finally, we also do not have core inflation (excluding food and fuel) print for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: April. The fall in international crude oil prices has not been passed on to domestic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pump prices of petrol and diesel. Though this makes domestic pump prices vulnerable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to any rise in international prices, on the current demand supply balance, oil prices are

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: likely to remain soft. Given the collapse in domestic demand, core inflation should

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: soften significantly from the current levels over the medium term. Input cost pressures

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: are also likely to ease due to a sharp decline in global commodity prices. Housing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation at less than 4 per cent during March-April was the lowest in the series. Gold

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: prices are expected to remain firm due to a flight to safety. On the whole, however,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: core inflation is expected to remain benign over the next few quarters. Even though

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: there is expected to be a V shaped recovery, the economy will still be left with a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: considerable slack, which will keep core inflation under check.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 60.     To sum up, economic activity is expected to contract in 2020-21. While supply

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lines are likely to be restored as lockdown is relaxed, demand would take far longer to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: revive to pre-COVID levels. Even as some support will be provided by government

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expenditure, overall consumption is likely to slow down due to a slump in private

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumption. More than private consumption, however, it is investment demand which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: is expected to be hit hard in this uncertain environment and may be a huge drag on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: economic activity in the near future with attendant implications for potential growth.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Therefore, concerted efforts need to be made to revive investment demand. Overall,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation over the medium term is expected to be benign. Monetary policy has been

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: eased significantly since February 2019 and the Government has also taken several

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: measures, which will help mitigate deleterious impact of COVID-19 on aggregate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: demand. However, an unprecedented collapse in demand calls for further easing of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: financing conditions. With the likely contraction in economic activity and the inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: outlook remaining soft, the policy space has opened up. I, therefore, vote for reducing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the policy repo rate by 40 basis points and keeping the stance accommodative as long

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: as it is necessary to revive growth, while ensuring that inflation remains within the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: target. Given the long transmission lags with which monetary policy operates, it is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: important to create enabling financing conditions so that economic activity takes off

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: swiftly as soon as normalcy is restored. Should the inflation trajectory turn out as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected, some more policy space may open up, going forward. For monetary policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: actions to transmit fully to the credit market, it is important that banks remain well

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: capitalised. Only banks with strong balance sheets could be expected to support

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lending activity as and when credit demand picks up.

lines: Statement by Dr. Michael Debabrata Patra

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 61.    In my view, the destruction of economic activity by COVID-19 and ensuing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lockdowns is much more deleterious in terms of loss of basic livelihood, economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: security, health and confidence than the range of estimates/projections of GDP and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: other macroeconomic aggregates suggest. In India, as in the rest of the world, external

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: trade, investment, manufacturing, services involving people – hospitality, tourism,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: aviation and construction – and investment have been the worst hit. Private

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumption is tenuously holding on to positive territory, but spending patterns have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: altered drastically away from the discretionary and to the essential. The large

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: monetary stimulus and fiscal effort are striving to put a floor under the aggregate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: demand. At the current juncture, the all-out effort is to maintain and sustain, with the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: hope that when life is secure, resources, energy and time can be marshalled to rebuild

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and revive.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 62.    In fact, my view is that the damage is so deep and extensive that India’s

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: potential output has been pushed down, and it will take years to repair.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 63.   In the deliberations of the MPC, my view is that the threats to growth have to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: be addressed frontally and aggressively, or risk a more dire outlook.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 64.    Meanwhile, the prolonged lockdown has thrown supply into disarray and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: interrupted the easing of inflation that had gotten underway after the January 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: peaking. Contemporaneous information suggests that the momentum in the prices of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: several food items, especially perishables, may be ebbing, with favourable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: implications for the evolution of headline inflation going forward. This suggests that the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: food price spike has very little persistence and dispersion (except in April 2020 when

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the lockdown started producing wider effects), and can be looked through for policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: purposes. The sustained loss of momentum of seasonally adjusted GDP growth over

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: eight consecutive quarters is depressing the underlying momentum of core inflation,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and this is likely to continue in the near term, as aggregate demand would take time

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to return to pre-COVID levels.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 65.     Relative prices tend to adjust within the budget constraint. For setting monetary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: policy, however, it is the absolute level of prices and its prospective movements that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: matter. This warrants a careful assessment of aggregate demand. Apart from the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: unidirectional loss of speed in real GDP growth, monetary conditions are also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: reflecting the fragile state of demand. While reserve money adjusted for the first round

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: CRR effects is expanding substantially in relation to its pace a year ago, this essentially

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: reflects the large monetary stimulus and the public’s flight to cash – currency in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: circulation expanded year-on-year by 18.4 per cent up to May 22, 2020 as against

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 14.9 per cent a year ago. In the current milieu in which banks are depositing sizeable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: balances with the Reserve Bank rather than lending/investing, the money multiplier at

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: which this reserve money expansion translates into money supply, has to be adjusted

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to include LAF reverse repos, which are essentially (remunerated) excess reserves.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: With this adjustment, the money multiplier would have effectively declined from its

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: normal level of 5.5 to about 4.5. This is showing up in the rate of money supply which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: has slowed below its secular trend; in fact, the negative money gap (actual rate of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: money supply minus its trend rate) has widened since 2019-20, especially from the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: second half. Both bank credit and investments are decelerating to multi-year lows,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pointing to badly dented demand and risk aversion. On the other hand, bank deposits

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: are growing faster than a year ago, driven by a precautionary savings instinct in these

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: times of heightened uncertainty. It is important to break this recessionary loop, shore

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: up the erosion in confidence, incentivise banks to invest and lend, and people to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: spend.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 66.     It is this context that should condition monetary policy actions and stance. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: MPC has decided to remain accommodative as long as it is necessary to revive growth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and mitigate the fallout of COVID-19. In keeping with this stance, the policy rate has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: been reduced by 75 basis points since February 2020 when the virus outbreak

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: assumed pandemic proportions. In the evolving configuration of growth and inflation,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: monetary policy can inspire confidence among households and businesses to break

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the vortex of public preference for deposits over spending and banks’ aversion to lend

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and invest. Ahead of turning to mend broken areas of activity, it is important to nurture

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the green shoots that have become visible – as in agriculture and allied activities – so

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: that they take root and grow. These considerations warrant backing up past actions

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and stance with another decisive reduction in the policy rate while persevering with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the accommodative stance. The experience of central banks has been that monetary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: policy acts best when it is reinforced by policy actions and stance in the same direction

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: repetitively till the desired objectives are achieved.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 67.    The size of the rate reduction needs to be calibrated to the space opened up

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: by the inflation outlook, after allowing for margins of error in these fluid and uncertain

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: times, while keeping in mind the ramifications of the size of the rate reduction for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: financial stability.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 68.    Accordingly, I vote for a reduction in the policy rate by 40 basis points while

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: maintaining the accommodative stance of monetary policy that has been reflected in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the resolutions of the MPC in the recent period.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 69.    The impact of COVID-19 on the domestic economy has turned out to be far

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: more severe than initially anticipated. Lockdowns across major economies have also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: severely impacted economic activity across the globe. In the April WEO, the IMF

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: projected the global economy to contract sharply by 3.0 per cent in 2020. GDP data

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: for Q1:2020 and more recent high frequency indicators emanating from major

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: advanced and emerging market economies, however, suggest that the contraction in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: global growth could be even deeper.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 70.    Domestic economic activity has been impacted severely by two months of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lockdown which was imposed to contain the spread of the COVID-19 pandemic and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: save human lives. High frequency indicators for March-April 2020 suggest a collapse

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: of demand. Industrial output, measured by the index of industrial production (IIP) for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: March, which included only seven days of the nation-wide lockdown, contracted by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 16.7 per cent. The contraction was spread across sectors, with manufacturing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: shrinking by 20.6 per cent and capital goods production by 35.6 per cent. Private

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumption, which has been the bedrock of domestic demand, also plummeted with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the production of consumer durables falling by 33.1 per cent in March 2020 and that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: of non-durables by 16.2 per cent.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 71.    Limited data that are available for April suggest a further shrinkage in demand.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: India’s merchandise trade slumped in April 2020, with exports contracting by 60.3 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: cent and imports by 58.6 per cent. While railway freight traffic shrank by 35.3 per cent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in April, steel consumption declined by 90.9 per cent. PMI manufacturing and PMI

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: services in April slipped to unprecedented levels of 27.4 and 5.4 respectively.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 72.    Bank credit growth continues to be tepid, suggesting weak demand. Non-food

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: credit of scheduled commercial banks (SCBs) grew by 6.5 per cent (y-o-y) as on May

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 8, 2020 as compared with 13.0 per cent a year ago. During 2020-21 so far (up to May

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 8, 2020), however, banks’ investment in commercial paper, shares, bonds and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: debentures increased by ₹66,757 crore as against a decline of ₹8,822 crore during

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the same period last year, reflecting the impact of targeted long term repo operations

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: (TLTROs) of the Reserve Bank.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 73.   The only silver lining has been the agriculture sector – the summer sowing is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: progressing well. As on May 10, 2020, summer sowing of all crops in the country was

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: much higher by 43.7 per cent (37.9 per cent for rice, 74.8 per cent for pulses and 29.3

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: per cent for oilseeds) over last year’s acreage. The harvest of rabi crop is almost

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: complete. The forecast of normal monsoon by the India Meteorological Department

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: (IMD) augurs well for agriculture output and farm incomes.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 74.    On inflation, the headline consumer price index (CPI) for April 2020 was not

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: available on account of nationwide lockdown. Among the major groups, for which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: indices were released, food group inflation edged up in April 2020 (to 8.6 per cent from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 7.8 per cent in the previous month) due to a broad-based increase in inflation across

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the food sub-groups.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 75.    The Reserve Bank has been proactively managing liquidity. Since the MPC

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: statement of February 6, 2020 the Reserve Bank has announced liquidity augmenting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: measures of ₹9.42 lakh crore (4.6 per cent of GDP). Monetary transmission has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: continued to improve with the weighted average lending rate (WALR) on fresh rupee

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: loans declining by 43 bps in March; the decrease since February 2019, when the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: current cycle of rate cut began, being 114 bps.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 76.    Looking ahead, the growth outlook has deteriorated sharply. There is still

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: uncertainty as to when the COVID curve will flatten. Even as the supply side is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected to ease gradually as the lockdown related restrictions are phased out, it is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the demand side, which will continue to weigh heavily on economic activity for some

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: time to come. The impact of the fiscal and contingent liability measures announced by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the government on demand creation needs to be carefully watched. Quick

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: implementation of various reform measures can also inject growth impulses into the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Indian economy in the medium to long term. Economic activity, however, is expected

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to contract in the first half of the year before recovering gradually in the second half of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 2020-21 on the back of various fiscal, monetary and liquidity measures undertaken in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the recent period. Overall, the GDP growth in 2020-21 is estimated to remain in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: negative territory. The pace of recovery will be contingent upon the containment of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pandemic and how quickly social distancing/lockdown measures are phased out.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 77.     It has become challenging to assess the inflation outlook in the absence of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: complete information on CPI. Food inflation is expected to moderate in the coming

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: months as transport impediments and supply lines get eased. This is also corroborated

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: by data on 22 essential commodities released by the Department of Consumer Affairs,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: which show that prices of several food items have declined in this month so far from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the April levels. The meltdown in demand is also likely to result in a significant easing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: of price pressures in core goods and services. Weak demand conditions in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: presence of strong favourable base effects could result in headline inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: falling below the target rate during Q3 and Q4 of 2020-21.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 78.     Since the last off-cycle MPC meeting on March 27, 2020 macro-financial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: conditions have deteriorated rapidly. The fast evolving trade-offs between growth and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation have underscored the need for intensifying the assessment of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: macroeconomic outlook, and the preparedness to act pre-emptively to address the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: swiftly shifting underlying economic and financial conditions and what they portend for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the path going forward. Delaying timely monetary policy response by two weeks,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: waiting for the bi-monthly MPC meeting schedule, could be costly and irreversible. In

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: fact, such a delay in monetary policy action could potentially become a source of risk

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: itself to the deteriorating growth outlook. Monetary policy is a rapid deployment

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: instrument of public policy, and monetary authorities, forewarned by prescient

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: assessment of the prevailing macroeconomic conditions, have to be nimble. It is in this

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: context that the scheduled second bi-monthly meeting of the MPC was advanced from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: June 3 to 5, 2020 to May 20 to 22, 2020.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 79.     As pointed out in the foregoing paragraphs, the risks to growth have become

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: far more severe than in our assessment at the end of March 2020. It is expected that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: this diagnosis will be validated by hard data over the next few months, even as the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: overall outlook continues to be highly uncertain. The key challenge for monetary policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: at this stage is to resuscitate domestic demand to avoid any harmful effect on income

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and employment in the short run and potential growth over the medium term. For

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: strengthening domestic demand, it is important to revive consumer and business

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: confidence. The Government has already announced a variety of measures to provide

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: economic support to various sectors of the economy and protect the interests of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: vulnerable sections of society. The Reserve Bank has also been proactively managing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: liquidity to ensure that funds flow to all productive sectors of the economy. RBI has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also been easing monetary policy to reduce the cost of funds/capital to revive domestic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: demand. While all these measures should help support demand as and when the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: nation-wide lockdown is lifted, but given the enormity of a collapse in demand, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: need is to move ahead full throttle to ease financing conditions further so as to revive

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumption and revitalize investment. Since banks are the key players in financing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumption and investment, it is also imperative that they remain adequately

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: capitalised. The benign inflation outlook that is expected for the second half of 2020-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 21, coupled with the rising probability of a sharper loss of growth momentum in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: near-term, has provided us with more policy space to ease financial conditions further

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and stimulate growth. Since the outbreak of COVID-19, the MPC has voted for front-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: loading its actions. In view of the deteriorating outlook, it is critical to reinforce these

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: actions in sync with the space provided by the underlying conditions.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 80.     In assessing the magnitude of policy space, it is important to take into account

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the weak growth momentum, the need for prioritising growth in view of the less risky

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation outlook, and the need to assure benign financial conditions ahead of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: recovery taking hold so that confidence is sustained. Considering all these factors, a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: reduction in the policy rate by 40 basis points would be appropriate. Accordingly, I vote

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: for reducing the policy repo rate by 40 basis points from 4.4 per cent to 4.0 per cent. I

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also vote for persevering with the accommodative stance of monetary policy. The RBI

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: remains watchful and shall not hesitate to use any conventional and unconventional

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: tool in its toolkit to revive the macro economy and preserve financial stability while

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: adhering to the inflation target.

lines: 21.      A large decline in global growth will also affect our exports adversely. Growth in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the service sector, the largest sector in the economy, will also be affected because

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: discretionary spending will fall. It is important to understand that consumer services –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: retail, hotels, restaurants etc. – are a corollary of growth. In contrast, producer services –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: finance, IT, Real Estate, Transportation etc. - are producers of growth and also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: employment. COVID-19 will impact both, slowing the momentum on the growth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: turnaround that had set in in the last few months.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 22.    Unfortunately, there is no short-cut at the current juncture apart from the lockdown.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 23.   What should the monetary policy strategy be in this situation? There are three

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: considerations.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 24.   First, monetary policy should minimize the fall in aggregate demand, i.e., we

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: should minimize the extent of permanent damage done to growth by the COVID-19 shock.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: Hence, the required cut in the policy rate should be large given the severity of the shock.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: What is required is in the nature of an insurance cut.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 25.    In a demand deficient economy, a large rate cut, however, will be akin to pushing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: on a string. I have been raising this concern in several previous policy reviews justifying

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the need for more structural reforms. This concern prevents me from voting for an even

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: larger cut in the policy rate this time.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 26.     Second, what is the appropriate division of labor between monetary policy, liquidity

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: policy, social insurance policy, and fiscal policy in stimulating aggregate demand?

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 27.     I see the current fiscal stimulus (1.7 lakh crore which is about 0.8% of GDP,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: announced on March 26, 2020) more in the nature or a relief measure (social insurance)

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: rather than a stimulus. A relief is not a permanent fix. The idea of the measure announced

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: by the government is to weather the storm so that no one has to go without food and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: spending on essential items. The effect of this measure will be to lead to a small rise in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: consumption in the short run, but the effect will dissipate quickly.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 28.     On liquidity policy, a large number of measures will be announced today which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: include prudential and forbearance measures. A series of liquidity measures have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: already been enacted (Forex swaps, LTROs, operation twist, OMOs). Combined, these

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: measures amount to a “carpet-bombing” of the financial system with liquidity and will help

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: flatten yields in those parts of the financial system where fire-sales have pushed up credit

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: spreads. The stabilization of financial markets will help improve economic outcomes.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 29.     On fiscal policy, I await details on a second stimulus package that will possibly be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: announced by the government. The challenge will be this: estimates of the size of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: government spending multiplier internationally across a wide variety of studies, unless

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the economy has a lot of slack or is stuck at the zero lower bound, tend to be small, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: typically smaller than one (an increase in Government spending by 100 Rs. increases

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: GDP by less than 100 Rs.). Tax multipliers, on the other hand, tend to be larger (greater

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: than one). This suggests that the ideal fiscal stimulus to deal with COVID-19 should be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: loaded on the tax side rather than the government spending side. India however has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: limited tax penetration. This is going to be the main design challenge.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 30.   Finally, what is the threat to our medium term inflation aim because of the COVID-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 19 shock?

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 31.     While it is hard to assess -- in a precise manner -- the one year ahead level of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: inflation given the current situation, new disinflationary forces have emerged since the

lines: 33.   Taking monetary policy, fiscal policy, social insurance policy, and liquidity policy

lines: together, a 50 bps cut in the policy rate is appropriate at the current juncture.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

lines: monetary policy has never proved able to reverse large shocks. It only helps to mitigate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the worse effects of shocks, and speeds up the recovery.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 35.    Once the COVID-19 pandemic subsides, is there likely to be a quick return to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: normal? I am hopeful because production capacity has not been destroyed. However, I

lines: 37.    The near nationwide lockdown due to the COVID-19 outbreak has brought

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: economic activity to almost a standstill. The global economy has also been adversely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: impacted by the unprecedented economic and humanitarian crisis, the severity of which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: will depend on the depth, duration and diffusion of the evolving pandemic.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 38.     Depending on the severity of the situation and the duration of the lockdown, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: crisis has ramifications for domestic growth stemming from supply side disruptions,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: contraction in demand, slowdown in global growth and a loss in consumer confidence as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: well as investor sentiment. The supply chain of key industries is likely to be disrupted due

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: to restricted access to imported raw materials. The manufacturing sector is expected to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: drastically slow down due to closure of factories while consumer demand and investment

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: spending are also likely to drop sharply. The services sector is expected to be impacted

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the most due to restrictions on travel, transport, hospitality, tourism, and professional and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: financial services. Construction activity is also expected to drop. Trade is expected to take

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: a hit due to a fall in domestic demand and contraction in global growth. Since the shock

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: to output is global, it is unlikely that any country can act as an engine of growth to pull the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: world out of this situation.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 39.   According to the second advance estimates of the NSO released in February 2020,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: GDP growth print for Q3: 2019-20 was 4.7% and is expected to be 5% for the full FY

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 2019-20. However, this may be difficult to achieve due to the negative impact of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: coronavirus disease, which gained momentum in February in the country.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 40.     The slowdown in economic activity poses challenges for financial stability,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: especially in the wake of recent development in one private sector bank. Financial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: conditions have also become tight, with massive sell-offs by foreign portfolio investors in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the debt and equity markets. For the same reason, the Indian rupee has also come under

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: downward pressure. However, the Reserve Bank has done well to take various steps to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: inject large liquidity into the system and ensure stability in the financial markets.

lines: 41.     On the inflation front, the trajectory of headline CPI inflation is heading downwards,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: with easing of food prices in the light of record foodgrains and horticulture production. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: in the current scenario, inflation is expected to remain soft and does not pose as a major

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: challenge. The top-most priority, therefore, is to minimise the negative impact of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: pandemic on economic growth. This necessitates a multi-pronged approach comprising

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: monetary, fiscal and other policy measures, as well as steps to contain the spread of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: COVID-19.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 43.     The Reserve Bank has already taken several measures to inject substantial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: liquidity into the system. It is also widening the existing policy rate LAF corridor to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

lines: servicing. The Government of India has also announced a comprehensive fiscal package

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: covering cash transfers and food security for vulnerable sections of society. Fiscal policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: has a major role to play in combating the economic effects of the pandemic.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 44.     Given the extraordinary crisis, in order to revive growth and mitigate the economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: with heightened uncertainty and a near-standstill in economic activity, this may not

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: necessarily lead to an increase in borrowing, but should raise consumer confidence and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: investor sentiment, going forward. It may be better to conserve some policy space for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: later, when those binding constraints are removed and the economy will require a further

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: boost to recover from the pandemic. I also vote to maintain the accommodative stance

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: as long as necessary to revive growth.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 19 all over the globe are pushing the world economy into unprecedented recession. At

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: forward, CPI inflation in India four quarters ahead is most likely to be well below the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: targeted 4 per cent. Therefore, remaining within the mandate given by the Act, this is the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: right time for MPC to act decisively and for RBI to provide a major booster dose to the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: economy basically to restore confidence of producers, consumers, investors and savers.

lines: 47.     In recent weeks, there has been a drastic change in the global and domestic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: and disrupted economic activity in many countries. The outbreak of coronavirus initially

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: began as a supply shock, but it soon also became a demand shock with restrictions on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: travel, tourism, and cut back in non-essential spending due to lockdowns. Reflecting the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: severe impact that the COVID-19 is expected to have on the global economy, financial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: markets have been witnessing turbulence.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 48.     The authorities in many countries, including central banks, have unleashed

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: financing conditions have tightened due to a flight to safety. That there has been so much

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: flight for safety and demand for liquidity that there has been large selling even in gold,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: pulling down its prices, which normally rise in an uncertain environment.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: downward drag on global growth are continuously being revised. However, it is now clear

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: and impaired supply chains, there is, in fact, a serious risk that the global economy will

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: even slip into recession in 2020. In the face of slowing down of global growth, huge global

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: debt accumulated after the global financial crisis may also pose serious threats to global

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: financial stability.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: manufacturing in January and PMI composite in February were at eight-year high.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

lines: 54.     On the whole, it has been hard to clearly assess the macroeconomic outlook at

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: this point of time. The COVID-19 pandemic has led to a series of a priori indistinguishable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

lines: identification of which for modelling purposes is practically impossible. Furthermore,

lines: assigning probabilities on outcomes in times of infrequent but high-impact events such as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

lines: vote for persevering with the accommodative stance as long as necessary to revive

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: remains within the target.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

lines: an adverse feedback loop to worsen the growth outlook even further. In this emerging

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

lines: demand, and thereby create enabling conditions for businesses to normalise production

lines: and supply chains as and when the situation becomes conducive for resumption of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: economic activity. The space for policy action has opened up in view of the disinflationary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 1, 3 and 4, 2019

lines: points. I also vote to keep the stance as accommodative.

lines: 78.     Since the last policy in February 2019, there has been further weakening of domestic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: growth impulses, with global growth slowdown posing major headwinds to India’s exports.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: Inflation has continued to surprise on the downside. CPI inflation for January and February

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: averaged 2.3 per cent as against projection of 2.8 per cent for the January-March quarter of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019

lines: 79.    CPI inflation excluding food and fuel moderated from 5.6 per cent in December to 5.4

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: per cent in February. The spike in prices in the health and education sub-groups in December

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: proved to be a one-off phenomenon. The food group continued to be in deflation for the fifth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: consecutive month in February. Inflation in the fuel and light sub-group unexpectedly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: collapsed from 4.5 per cent in December to 1.2 per cent in February, with electricity prices

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: remaining in deflation. Inflation expectations of households, measured by the Reserve Bank’s

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: survey of households, declined in the February round over the previous round by 40 basis

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: points each for the three-month ahead and the one-year ahead horizons. With this, inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: expectations have declined cumulatively by as much as 160 basis points for the three-month

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: ahead and 170 basis points for one-year ahead horizons in the last four survey rounds.

lines: 80.     In comparison with the February policy, CPI inflation projection is now revised

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: downwards by 30-40 basis points to 2.4 per cent in Q4:2018-19, 2.9-3.0 per cent in H1:2019-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: 20 and 3.5-3.8 per cent in H2, with risks broadly balanced. This baseline inflation scenario,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: however, is subject to several uncertainties, especially from crude oil and food prices. More

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: precisely, the uncertainties/risks include: (i) the highly uncertain outlook for oil prices, which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: are vulnerable to both upward pressure due to continuing OPEC production cuts, as well as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: downward pressure due to further slowing down of the global economy; (ii) the risk of an

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: abrupt reversal in vegetable prices, which may get accentuated due to deficient monsoon

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: should there be El Niño conditions; and (iii) inflation excluding food and fuel may soften

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: further from the present levels if the recent slowdown in domestic economic activity

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: intensifies. The fiscal situation at the general government level also needs a careful vigil.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: Given India’s large dependence on imports of crude oil, stability in international crude oil

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: prices is critical for domestic macroeconomic stability.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: 81.      Moving on to economic activity, high frequency indicators suggest a further loss of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: pace in growth. Private consumption has been weakening as reflected in deceleration in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: growth of passenger car sales and domestic air passenger traffic, weak performance of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: consumer durables and non-durables, and continuing contraction in non-oil non-gold imports.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: Investment activity has also decelerated due to contraction in production of capital goods in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: January and imports of capital goods in February. On the supply side, industrial growth has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: weakened as reflected in deceleration in the growth of index of industrial production (IIP) for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: January; the growth of core industries for February remained sluggish. However, capacity

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: utilisation (CU) in the manufacturing sector has improved and is also above the long-term

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: average. In the services sector, sales of commercial vehicles, port freight traffic and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: international air freight traffic contracted during February. However, indicators of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: construction sector, viz., growth in consumption of steel and production of cement, continued

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: to show healthy growth.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: 82.     Overall financing conditions have continued to improve as reflected in the total flow

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: of resources to the commercial sector. However, bank credit flows to micro and small as well

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: as medium industries remain extremely weak. GDP growth for 2019-20 has been revised

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: downwards to 7.2 per cent – in the range of 6.8-7.1 per cent in H1:2019-20 and 7.3-7.4 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: cent in H2 – with risks evenly balanced.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: 83.     Investment demand is losing traction and a deceleration in exports may further impact

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: investment activity. With the inflation outlook looking benign and headline inflation expected

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: to remain below target in the current year, it becomes necessary to address the challenges to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: sustained growth of the Indian economy. Hence, I vote for reducing the policy repo rate by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: 25 basis points. I would like to state here that there is a need to consider interest rate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: adjustments, not necessarily in the conventional way of 25 bps or multiples thereof. This idea

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: needs further debate and discussion. Further, with several uncertainties facing the economy, it

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 2-4, 2019
lines: is appropriate to maintain the neutral stance of monetary policy.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: are invisible. The forecast indicates that headline inflation is likely to course below 4 per cent up

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: to the third quarter of 2019-20, thus securing the target over a one-year ahead time horizon.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: Significantly, the path of inflation has been adjusted downwards by 40-80 basis points since the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: surveyed households, businesses and professional forecasters have made sizable corrections in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: their inflation expectations over the next twelve months; consumers are more sanguine about the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: evolving price situation than before; and cost pressures are moderate with delayed and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: incomplete pass-through to selling prices. The key insight is provided by the direction of these

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: adjustments, not their levels.
