lines: 56.     As the amended RBI Act enjoins us, if the primary target for headline inflation is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: achieved on a reasonably lasting basis, it opens up some headroom to address the objective of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: growth. The MPC will need to closely monitor the evolution of these disparately driven price

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: movements and calibrate the monetary policy stance accordingly. If the momentum of food price

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: changes in the next few months indicates that inflation is likely to rise above 4 per cent and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: persist in the upper reaches of the tolerance band, pre-emptive action will be warranted to ensure

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: that the primary objective of maintaining price stability is defended and achieved lastingly.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 57.    Turning to the outlook for growth, domestic activity remains resilient, but it appears to be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: shedding some speed in the second half of 2018-19. Dark clouds seem to be gathering over the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: horizon. High frequency indicators suggest that the pick-up in investment in the first half of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 2018-19 may have lost some strength in the second half and considerable uncertainty shrouds the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: prospects of an improvement in private investment – especially into new capacity addition – and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: capacity utilisation in manufacturing is straining above trend in view of the still weak capex

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: cycle.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 58.     The biggest downside risk to growth is likely to stem from global developments – the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: weakening of global growth in the second half of 2018 may prolong into coming quarters; global

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: trade and investment may be impacted by ongoing trade tensions; and tail risks from policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: uncertainties in systemically important economies may crystallise. Should a deeper than

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: currently anticipated global slowdown take hold, domestic activity could be dragged down by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: retarding impulses transmitted through the channels of exports and investment. In this scenario,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: it is prudent to preserve sufficient policy space to insulate the economy from adverse external

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: shocks and boost the domestic economy in an opportune manner rather than deplete it in haste.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 59.      Accordingly, I vote for a 25 basis points reduction in the policy rate and a pre-emptive

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: shift to a neutral policy stance.

lines: 60.     Since the December monetary policy meeting, food inflation prints have continued to be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019

lines: 62.     Based on these data and other considerations, RBI’s quarterly inflation projections over

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: the next 12-month horizon have been further revised downward and imply headline inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 63.    My understanding of composition effects and risks around these projections is as follows:

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 64.    One, inflation excluding food and fuel remains elevated and persistent, so it seems crucial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: to understand if the sharp increase in momentum observed in health and education components is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: one-off or not. While it seems reasonable to treat it as one-off for now, if it does sustain then it

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: could push inflation excluding food and fuel into uncomfortable territory. Unfortunately, there is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: no decisive way to resolve this issue other than to wait for and analyse a few more prints.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 65.     Second, international Brent crude prices have stabilised in the short run. Nevertheless, it

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: is too early to forget or rule out the wild gyrations from geopolitical risks, as were observed over

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: the past six months. Given our oil imports and the implied current account deficit effects,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: headline inflation responds particularly adversely to upside risk from crude oil prices.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 66.    Third, the recent low momentum in food prices is assumed to have a structural

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: component over the next 12-month horizon as there appears to be a supply glut in several food

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: items at both domestic and international levels. Vegetable prices, however, are vulnerable to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: sudden reversal from their deflationary momentum.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 67.     More importantly, the assumption of sustained low momentum in food prices leads to a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: consideration of the risk of agrarian distress. Such distress will necessitate a political-economy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: response in the form of fiscal support to the agrarian economy in the short run; effects of such

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: fiscal support may play out partly over the next 12 months and partly beyond. Besides

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: stimulating rural demand and restoring rural wages, such a response could get generalised into

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: headline inflation; this could arise, for example, by aggravating the input cost push arising in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: financing of the real economy from fiscal and quasi-fiscal financing, especially from national

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: small savings fund (NSSF) into bank deposit rates and from fiscal/quasi-fiscal market

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: borrowings into corporate bond yields. Our counterfactual exercises suggest that such upward

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: pressure on headline inflation would require commensurate policy rate action over the next 12

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: months.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 68.     In other words, the assumption of particularly benign food inflation in the short run

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: imparts significant upside risk to the inflation trajectory, at the short- and/or medium-term

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: horizons, from the fiscal adjustments that would be necessary to address resulting agrarian

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: distress and to boost rural demand.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 69.    Fourth, while inflation expectations have moved downward in the most recent survey,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: when compared to the December 2017 survey, they remain higher at 3-month horizon. In other

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: words, anchoring of inflation expectations of households is still an ongoing process and it is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: somewhat early to assume its sustenance going forward based on the most recent adjustment.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 70.     On balance, I remain concerned about (i) the elevated level of inflation excluding food

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: and fuel; (ii) upward risks that could emanate from oil prices and fiscal implications of sustained

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: food deflation; and, (iii) lack of adequate and sustained downward adjustment in household

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: inflation expectations over the past 12 months.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: 71.     Turning to growth, concerns around global growth, especially in major advanced

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: economies and emerging markets embroiled in tariff wars, have gathered momentum. In

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: response, several central banks have decided to be patient with their rate hike plans and/or have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: revised growth projections downwards. My assessment is that unless these concerns turn into

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: recessionary risks, they could in fact be positive for the Indian economy as a reduction in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: aggregate global demand keeps Brent crude oil prices under check.

lines: 72.     Domestic indicators for economic activity are overall mixed. Overall corporate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019
lines: performance in Q3 of 2018-19 was stable; capacity utilisation – absolute or seasonally-adjusted –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 5-7, 2019

lines: 61.    CPI inflation rose for the sixth consecutive month in December. Food inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: increased further even as pulses continued to deflate. Fuel group inflation rose sharply in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: November and remained elevated thereafter. With rising input prices, inflation is getting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: increasingly generalised. Inflation expectations have remained elevated.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: 62.     Looking forward, inflation in the baseline scenario is projected to remain above the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: target of 4 per cent throughout 2018-19. There are several upside risks to inflation, especially

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: from the staggered impact of HRA increases by various state governments (the direct effect

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: on the CPI of the pure statistical adjustment has to be looked through, but not the second

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: round effects driven by, say, expectations); policy for arriving at the minimum support prices

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: for Kharif crops; and the fiscal slippage as indicated in the Union Budget, which also has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: attendant “crowding-out” implications with regard to the cost of private domestic credit. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: evolving global macro backdrop is a concern. Tighter monetary policy by systemically

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: important central banks, viz., the US Federal Reserve, combined with a looser US fiscal

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: policy stance has the potential to imbue financial turbulence with concomitant consequences,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: especially for emerging markets. International crude oil prices increased significantly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: between December and early February, which is worrisome. However, oil prices could

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: moderate if there is a strong supply response. Effective supply management by the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: government, as in the recent past, could help in keeping food inflation under check. Further,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: overall capacity utilisation in industry, according to surveys, is restrained.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: 63.     Domestic economic growth impulses are strengthening. Manufacturing activity has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: picked up. The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) expanded for the sixth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: consecutive month in January, led by new orders. There are also early signs of revival of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: investment activity. Many service sector indicators have shown robust growth such as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: commercial vehicle sales, domestic & international air passenger traffic, and foreign tourist

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: arrivals. The services PMI expanded sequentially in December and January, supported by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: higher business activity. Credit growth is picking up and is also becoming broad-based. GVA

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: growth in 2018-19 is forecast at 7.2 per cent, which will be a significant improvement over the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: current year.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: 64.    Although inflation risks have increased in recent months, incoming data should

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: provide greater clarity about the persistence of inflationary pressures. The economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: recovery is also at a nascent stage and calls for a cautious approach at this juncture. I,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: therefore, vote for keeping the policy repo rate on hold while maintaining a neutral stance.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: the economic growth prospects in the near term. I also do not share its over-concerns for the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: upside risks on inflation and over-optimism on economic growth front. In my opinion, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: inflation situation is under reasonable control and is likely to remain well within the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: acceptable range during the foreseeable future because after a couple of months favourable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: base effects will set in. The real cause of concern right now is the economic recovery and its

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: slow pace. Fiscal space is more or less exhausted but the space for the monetary boost has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: fortunately been available now for a relatively long period. Had the policy rate been cut to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 5.75 per cent in June 2017 as I had argued then, the economic recovery would have been far

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: more rapid and we would have been in a much better position. Although we have missed the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: bus, it is still better late than never. In my opinion, we must cut the policy rate by at least 25

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: basis points to begin with if we want to be on conservative side, because enough space existed

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: all along. The specific reasons for my recommendation are as follows:

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: i)   Although the recent most round of RBI’s household inflationary expectation survey

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: shows an increase of about 60 basis points (bps) for inflation one year ahead, overall it

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: shows a substantial decline of about 280 bps over the last year or so. A very consistent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: and more reliable result is obtained from the Indian Institute of Management

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: Ahmedabad (IIMA) latest business expectation survey with more than 2100 responses

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: that shows the headline CPI inflation expectation one year ahead to be 3.71 per cent –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: well below the RBI target of 4 per cent. The standard deviation for this estimate is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: also relatively low. Thus, inflationary expectations are very well anchored and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: inflation control does not seem to be a major issue in the near future, i.e. over next 6 to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 12 months.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: ii)   On the other hand, the RBI surveys show that consumer confidence on income,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: employment and overall economic environment is very low and declining in recent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: times. Companies still lack the pricing power and experience squeeze in their profit

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: margins.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: iii)   Better performing and financially sound companies according to the RBI surveys are

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: investing more in financial assets than in physical assets. They behave more like

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: savers than investors because the real rate of interest is too high to encourage long

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: term investment. Even consumers would be discouraged to consume durable goods. It

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: needs to be noted that the real rate of interest is the difference between nominal rate of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: interest and expected rate of inflation (and not the observed rate of inflation in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: recent past).

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: iv)   Despite the marginal economic recovery, the capacity utilization in Indian industry

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: according to the RBI surveys continues to be at low level of 72 per cent indicating

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: persistent existence of output gap. Service sector PMI is also declining and in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: pessimist zone.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: v)    The growth recovery expectation of RBI during the June-September quarter of 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: turned out to be a substantial overstatement. As against RBI’s expectation of 6.4 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: cent, the growth of real GVA during the quarter turned out to be only 6.1 per cent.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: Yet, the RBI has not revised its growth forecast from the earlier 6.7 percent for the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: year 2017-18. This implies that RBI now expects a higher growth of 7.0 and 7.8 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: cent respectively in the third and fourth quarters of 2017-18. This is highly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017

lines: practically non-existent and the conditions described in points (ii) to (iv) above are

lines: so as to continue with the policy inaction.

lines: 40.     Households’ inflation expectations have firmed up and are undermining consumer

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: confidence. The pressure of input costs may soon force corporations to reflect them in selling

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: prices as their margins get whittled down from absorbing these costs. Financial markets,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: especially the bond market segment, are scenting higher inflation in the air. The slosh of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: liquidity that marooned markets during the year so far is being steadily drained away by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017

lines: year, abstracting maturing securities under the market stabilisation scheme and forex

lines: operations.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 41.     The current phase of accommodation in the monetary policy stance – reduction of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: policy rate by 200 basis points - is one of the deepest barring the easing associated with the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: global financial crisis. Also, it has been more fully transmitted. In my view, this phase has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: matured; it is time now to signal its end and commence the withdrawal of accommodation,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: consistent with the evolving stance of liquidity management.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 42.     It is not that I am sanguine about growth; far from it. Rather than green shoots, my

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: sense is that the upturn of Q2 occurred on the back of replenishment of inventories, and more

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: incoming data are needed to tell us whether or not it is durable. The investment temper

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: remains dormant, as evident in the persisting slump in the rate of capital formation. It awaits

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: reforms that bite the bullet in terms of freeing up product and factor markets, removing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: barriers to entry and exit, and rekindling productivity and competitiveness all around. As

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: growth regains solid ground, it could likely sustain inflation above the target.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 43.     The time has come for monetary policy to take guard and be ready to go on to the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: front foot.

lines: 44.     The global commodity cycle now seems to have turned with oil prices having also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: rebounded recently. This has created significant input cost pressures in the economy, which at

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: some stage may get passed on to retail prices. Vegetable prices have also firmed up, creating

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: uncertainty around the extent of seasonal winter moderation in prices. These factors have put

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: headline inflation on a trajectory that will most likely cross the MPC target rate of 4 per cent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: rather soon and remain above the target in the medium term (even after excluding the HRA

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: impact).

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 45.     Oil price evolution remains a particular concern. The shale gas response

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: notwithstanding, improving global demand appears to be playing an important role in shaping

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: oil prices along with the extension of OPEC’s production cuts. This development poses

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: difficult domestic policy challenges – countercyclical adjustment in cess would require fiscal

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: balancing elsewhere, whereas lack of such adjustment would imply pressure on domestic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: inflation (temporarily latent, since the price pass-through at pumps has not been immediate).

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 46.     The adverse change in overall terms of trade given the commodity cycle upturn has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: likely also weakened drivers of growth. Nevertheless, there has been some respite in the last

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: quarter’s growth prints as well as some of the high frequency indicators of real economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: activity in recent months. Our research team’s output gap estimates show some closure,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: attributable in part to improved credit growth and overall flow of financial resources to the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: commercial sector.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 47.      Output gap remains somewhat negative as reflected in present low capacity utilisation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: and high inventory. However, gradually improving credit metrics in several distressed sectors

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: should pave way for improved investment over the next year. This process is expected to be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: further supported as cases referenced to Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) resolve,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: facilitate consolidation, and restore pricing power. As public sector banks raise capital,

lines: 48.     There seems little scope for accommodation or for change of stance at the present

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: juncture. Hence, I vote to keep the repo rate at 6 per cent with neutral stance. Incoming data

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: will be key to shape the policy going forward. I remain keen to (i) understand the impact of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: Goods and Services Tax (GST) on price levels as its rollout stabilises; (ii) assess in coming

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: months the robustness of growth revival in GVA manufacturing; and (iii) track the impact of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: commodity prices on the Indian economy and markets. In parallel, the Reserve Bank is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: examining options to improve the transmission of its policy rate actions from banks to

lines: borrowers.

lines: 49.    The inflation scenario has evolved by and large along anticipated lines even as there

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: was some unexpected firming up of food prices in October. (I say by and large because prints

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: have been volatile throughout the year.) Inflation is now projected to be marginally higher,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: going forward, as the recent increase in oil prices is likely to sustain. Food inflation, led by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: vegetables, remains highly variable, while deflation in pulses continues. The impact of higher

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: house rent allowance (HRA) of central government employees on housing inflation will peak

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: in December.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 50.      There are several risks to the projected inflation trajectory. First, inflation expectations

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: of households for both three-month ahead and one-year ahead periods in the latest round of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: the Reserve Bank’s survey moved up. The percentage of households expecting inflation to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: rise at a faster rate than the current level was the highest since end-2013. Second, rising input

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: cost pressures across the board for both manufacturing and services have raised the risk of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: pass-through to output prices, especially because the growth momentum is projected to gain

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: strength in the second half of the year. Third, fiscal slippage concerns linger on. Should this

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: risk materialise, it would have implications for the inflation outlook. These risks to the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: inflation trajectory could, however, be alleviated to some extent by the expected seasonal

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: moderation in vegetable prices and the pass-through of recent reduction in GST rates on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: certain goods and services to retail prices.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 51.     The acceleration in GVA growth in Q2:2017-18 (as projected in October) is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: comforting, especially because it was underpinned by a sharp increase in manufacturing.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: Growth in gross capital formation continued to recover. Going forward, lower rabi sowing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: and lower reservoir level pose a downside risk to agriculture activity. However, on the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: industrial front, the Reserve Bank’s industrial outlook survey points to an improvement in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: manufacturing sector business expectations in Q3. Various indicators of service sector

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: activity, however, present a mixed picture. Financial conditions have improved significantly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: in the recent period as reflected in large capital raised from the primary capital market and a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: pick-up in bank credit growth. These perhaps may be indicating a long-awaited (modest)

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: upturn in an investment cycle.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: 52.     The macroeconomic situation has remained broadly unchanged since the last MPC

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: meeting in October 2017. However, the recent upturn in crude oil prices has emerged as a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: source of concern. Several uncertainties, especially on the fiscal and external fronts, persist. It

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: is, therefore, important to be vigilant. Hence, I vote for status quo in the policy rate, while

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: maintaining the stance as neutral; this allows us the flexibility to respond appropriately to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 5-6, 2017
lines: incoming data.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: gap is calculated on levels and not rates of growth, which implies that the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: negative output gap would start narrowing only when the current growth rate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: exceeds the potential rate of growth.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: vi)    There are some sceptics who argue that in India, where physical infrastructure

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: like roads and railways are over-crowded, a negative output gap simply cannot

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: exist. However, this argument is not valid since it is based on misconception

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: of the potential output. Congestion and overcrowding of certain type of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: physical infrastructure that could be due to wrong pricing and other policies

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: usually lead to very low productivity and indicate sub-optimal allocation of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: resources. This corroborates rather than negating the existence of a negative

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: output gap, because the potential output is defined in terms of the optimal

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: utilization of resources and not the actual utilization of resources. For instance,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: previously congested and hence inefficient roads have turned more efficient

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: with introduction of Goods and Services Tax (GST). The existing capital is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: better utilized and produces more output. Moreover, we need to recognize

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: that many other physical infrastructures like some airports, seaports, irrigation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: dams, hospitals, institutions of higher learning and several industrial plants

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: and machinery lie severely underutilized. Similarly a significant proportion of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: the labour force is underutilized. Therefore, negative output gap and its

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: widening at present as argued earlier cannot be denied.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: vii)   A rule-based monetary policy underlying the Flexible Inflation Targeting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: framework would necessitate a very well justified policy rate cut under the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: present circumstances. Real interest rate with expected future inflation rate in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: the economy currently is too high compared to most other countries. Now it

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: has started seriously hurting consumers of durable goods and producers and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: hence production. We also need to recognize explicitly the cost of sacrificing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: output growth in terms of unemployment and poverty when inflation situation is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: practically under control in the near to medium term. In order to address the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: problems created by expanding negative output gap, we need to bring down

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: the real interest rate in the economy. In my view, the policy rate should have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: been cut by 50 bps long back in June 2017. A cut of 25 bps in August was too

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: small and too late. We can still make the additional cut of 25 bps now if we

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: want to be extremely cautious. Otherwise, my opinion is that we have a space

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: for a cut of about 40 bps at present with due consideration to any possible

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: upward risk to future inflation.

lines: 41.    By contrast, all the factors conditioning the August rate reduction have either

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: not materialized or reversed - inflation excluding the HRA will likely exceed 4 per cent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: by the end of the year; inflation excluding food and fuel has turned up and will likely

lines: 42.    Current inflation developments and, in particular, deviations of outcomes from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: forecasts are shaping the future path of inflation in an ongoing error correction. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: primary objective of monetary policy enjoined by the RBI Act is challenged and the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: credibility of the MPC will be tested in the months ahead.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: 43.    Meanwhile, growth outcomes have surprised on the downside. Parsing the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: data reveals that agricultural and allied activities are growing at broadly the same

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: pace as in the first quarter of every year, while in the services sector, growth has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: accelerated. More recent indicators bear out these initial impulses. My sense is that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: the slowdown is troughing and activity will pick up in the second half of the year with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: better prospects for agriculture and services, and as the initial hitches associated with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: the GST get evened out.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: 44.     The slowdown is essentially located in manufacturing, and reinvigorating it

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: holds the key. The question is: is the weakness in manufacturing, which persists in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: spite of a reduction of 200 basis points in the policy rate, within the narrow remit of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: monetary policy? The advocacy for a further reduction in the policy rate is essentially

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: a case for lowering the cost of capital or the hurdle rate to a level at which a subdued

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: or even declining internal rate of return (IRR) becomes viable. In my view, this is not

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: a sustainable proposition and may even be self-fulfilling: chasing a deteriorating IRR

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: will only lead to higher inflation and no investment.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: 45.     All indications point to a deeper malaise that chains down animal spirits in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: private enterprise and cries out for a bold structural transformation of the business

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: and investment climate. The MPC’s resolution sets out the elements of the desired

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: policy response that will revive investment activity. A monetary policy reaction in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: absence of mobilising on these fronts is time-inconsistent – the MPC commits to an

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: inflation target over a medium term horizon but the persuasive pull of the transient

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: weakening of growth in the interregnum potentially undermines this commitment.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: 46.     I, therefore, vote for status quo, but only as long as inflation readings stay

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: within the target of 4 per cent. It is time to be in readiness to raise the policy rate to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: quell the underlying drivers of inflation if they strengthen further.

lines: 47.    Over the past few years, household inflation expectations have been steadily

lines: getting anchored down as they are adapting to the realised inflation outcomes.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: However, these expectations still remain relatively high, and are likely also

lines: manifested in the continuing high level of rural and non-rural wage growth. Recent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: materially. In such a scenario, it is important in my view for the Reserve Bank to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: persist steadfastly with its objective (and mandate) of keeping medium-term inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: within a striking distance of the target of 4 per cent.

lines: 48.    Real-time activity indicators have been volatile over the last two quarters and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: do not yet paint a clear picture. Hence, it is too early, in my view, to be able to isolate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: the transient component of the recent one-quarter loss of momentum over and above

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: the gradual decline in overall growth that has taken place since the Q1 of 2016-17.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: The gradual decline, which has turned our measures of output gap negative, is best

lines: explained by the deleveraging underway in the heavily indebted parts of the

lines: inadequate capital relative to impending losses on legacy assets.

lines: 49.    Corporate credit risk profile is showing some signs of improving gradually; the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: large distressed borrowers are being directed to the Insolvency and Bankruptcy code;

lines: and efforts are under way to concretely address public sector bank health in near

lines: future. These structural changes will revive the affected economic activity, but with a

lines: 51.     Headline CPI inflation has risen sharply in the last two months and there has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: been a broad-based increase in inflation excluding food and fuel. Even as the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: assessment of food prices going forward is generally favourable, some factors have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: imparted uncertainty to the near-term overall inflation outlook. Firstly, international

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: crude prices have firmed up significantly in the more recent period. Second, global

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: geo-political uncertainty and volatility in financial markets have increased. Third, a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: combination of farm loan debt waivers by state governments and the implementation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: of the pay commission award could entail some fiscal slippages and pose a risk to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: inflation. Notwithstanding some softening in the recent period, inflation expectations

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: show downward rigidity. This is reflected in the high increase in staff cost, particularly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: in the manufacturing sector.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: 52.    The loss of momentum in Q1 of 2017-18 has imparted a downside to the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: overall GVA outlook. The implementation of the GST has rendered prospects for the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: manufacturing sector uncertain in the short-term. This may further delay the

lines: acceleration in investment activity. However, there is a need for more data to assess

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: whether the recent headwinds in overall GDP growth prints are transient or

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: sustained. Prospects of agriculture are favourable, notwithstanding marginally lower

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: estimates of kharif production. The Reserve Bank’s industrial outlook survey points to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: overall business sentiment improving in Q3. The manufacturing PMI remained in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: expansion mode in August and September. Output of core industries showed a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: robust growth in August. Several lead indicators of services sector activity – sales of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: commercial and passenger vehicles, international air passenger traffic, railway freight

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: traffic, and foreign tourist arrivals – gained momentum in August. GVA growth is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: projected to strengthen in the second half of the year.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: 53.     Recent structural reforms may have had some impact on growth in the short

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: run. However, they will boost medium- to long-term growth prospects. To improve

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: immediate growth prospects, teething troubles relating to GST need to be addressed

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: expeditiously. Concerted efforts also need to be made to encourage investment

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: activity by removing various constraints. Resolution of stressed balance sheets of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: banks remains important for supporting a revival in the investment cycle. Finally,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017

lines: quarter as per the formula to help with monetary transmission.

lines: 54.    For keeping headline inflation close to 4 per cent on a durable basis, it is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting October 3-4, 2017
lines: important to recognise near and medium-term risks to the inflation outlook. We have

lines: 58.     After reaching a historic low in January 2017, CPI inflation in February 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: edged up, as expected. However, in all probability, inflation will significantly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: undershoot the 5 per cent target set for Q4 of 2016-17. Vegetable prices, which had

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: declined sharply during November 2016 to January 2017, seem to have stabilised but

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: may go up in the coming months due to a seasonal pick up. CPI inflation excluding

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: food and fuel remained sticky, especially services. Also, given the volatility in the CPI,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: it is not easy to read its evolution. The outlook for inflation faces several other risks.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: Input costs have been rising, which could be passed on to output prices as demand

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: strengthens. Further, the implementation of the HRA allowances recommended as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: part of the 7th CPC and the GST are risks, which could alter the inflation outturn in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: 2017-18. Uncertainty about the crude oil price trajectory is both ways given recent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: movements. Heightened geo-political risks continue to impart financial volatility in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: global markets.

lines: 59.    The latest data released by the CSO suggested that the impact of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: demonetisation on economic activity was modest. Economic activity is expected to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: pick up in 2017-18, although there is the usual uncertainty about the monsoon at this

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: stage. Several lead indicators suggest some improvement in the economic outlook.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: The industrial outlook survey of the Reserve Bank suggests positive outlook for the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: manufacturing sector. However, investment activity continues to be weak, but which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: is unsurprising given the headroom with respect to capacity utilisation in industry

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: (Reserve Bank surveys).

lines: 60.    Demonetisation induced liquidity facilitated faster monetary transmission.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: There is still room for banks to cut lending rates. For efficient transmission, it is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: important that interest rates on small savings are not out of line with interest rates on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: other comparable instruments in the financial system.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: 61.    Notwithstanding likely favourable base-effects in the next few months, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: outlook for inflation calls for close vigilance with a view to ensuring that the medium-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: term inflation trajectory evolves in line with the objective of bringing headline inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: closer to 4.0 per cent on a durable basis and in a calibrated manner. Therefore, I vote

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting April 5-6, 2017
lines: for maintaining the status quo in both the policy repo rate, and the stance.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: expected to fuel inflation well before the more sluggishly moving activity and demand

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: respond. If the seasonal upturn in vegetables prices and these reflationary effects coincide as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: they might by as early as March-April, monetary policy needs to be preemptively on guard.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
